notes.title: Patch "Alone No More" Is OUT!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460799/a20ec828040158ef82b1f109c2289b07281714f8.png[/img]

[h1]The wait is over![/h1] 
You all have been giving feedback how the game is not playable without friends or controllers! We have listened to your valuable feedback and here's our solution!

[h1]Artificial Idiots added[/h1]
You can add these guys to your game in the character selection! Play against up to 3 at once, in all your favorite game modes (at least if you had a chance to play you would have favorites). And since we're living the era of games that play themselves, we also added the option to put bots to play against each other, so playing without yourself is also now possible (no friends or players needed)! 

[h1]New Game Mode: Hockey World Championship 95[/h1]
Ever imagined how it is to shoot hockey players with a potato cannon to make room for your scoring shot? Well in this mode that's possible. Your goal in the mode is to make a goal (: - D). You can move the puck around by holding it in your feet and hit it towards a goal by melee attacks. New music track featured and unique fanfares when you make a goal! Artificial Idiots are not optimized for this mode yet. You can check out rest of the soundtrack here: https://soundcloud.com/lapakko/sets/drunkenpants-early-access

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460799/46c40c709e008c9fc76337817b47c699187ffa4e.png[/img]
[b]New Playable Character: Larry Salaminen[/b]
What would be a new game mode, without a new character fitting the theme of the mode? You didn't ask for this, but we did it anyway. Larry is actually quite a gentle guy, who ends up getting in trouble by accident and needs to defend himself from raging drunkards. He only uses brute force in self-defense. 

[h1]Other Stuff:[/h1]

[b]Master of the TV-Remote(Hold the remote)[/b]
-You only get scores for standing in the middle while holding the remote
-Visualization for changing channel added
-Particle effect with colors to show who has the remote right now

[b]Visual Upgrades[/b]
-We made the characters react with light and added bloom + color correction to make the game look a bit more finished.
-We replaced some of the very old art with some new (more towards the final style) art.
-New attack animations and minor tweaks for all characters

[b]UI Fixes[/b]
-Made the UI more intuitive and clear by removing some data from it. 

[b]Lots of  bug fixes[/b]
Fixed a lot of bugs and other quality of life issues. We had a detailed list of what we have been fixing, but it left to space to eat mushrooms and barf rainbows with its fellow Vikings. 

Thank you all for your great feedback, which has really helped us make the game a greater experience, so please keep it coming! 

Cheers -Firetail Games Crew
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460799/8387eca29d862e539e9abb860ecafec783b6e559.png[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix to menu, better usability and other bugfixes.
notes.content:
We added a hotfix to the menu's to improve usability and fixing issues that would break the game and require a reboot. We are currently working on making the menu's usable with only your mouse as well, hopefully, we'll get that patch live tomorrow. Thank you all for the feedback and bug reports, it really means a lot to us! :) 

You can also play the game now with your mouse and keyboard, there was some issue with floatiness in the controls, which are also now fixed. 

We also added a little "What's new" section to the start menu, to give you information on the games current state, without having to read through forums, here's a sneak peek of that:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460799/229377156817b531fb11dea46514efa2c0463065.png[/img]

Cheers -Firetail Games Crew

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31460799/8387eca29d862e539e9abb860ecafec783b6e559.png[/img]
